rules.signal: #c8f05a is reserved for action, selected proof state, and key emphasis.
rules.flatField: Use tonal layers and 1px rules instead of shadows.
rules.proof: Un-ingested benchmark results remain visibly pending.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-salience action on a surface.
components.css: .button-primary { color: #111613; background: #c8f05a; border: 1px solid #c8f05a; min-height: 47px; padding: 0 17px; } .button-primary:hover { color: #c8f05a; background: #111613; border-color: #111613; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Pipeline Strip
components.description: Four ruled stages make the solver mechanism visible before the proof chapter.
components.css: .pipeline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid #c9d0c8; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9d0c8; } .pipeline-step { min-height: 90px; border-right: 1px solid #c9d0c8; }

components.name: Benchmark Ledger
components.description: A dark correctness diagram followed by a ruled list of harness contracts.
components.css: .benchmark-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 1fr 1fr 130px; min-height: 63px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9d0c8; }

narrative.overview: A light technical field where the solver shows its mechanism and evidence without decorative distance. One acid signal marks action and verification; ink, water tones, and rules carry the rest.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use chartreuse only for action, selected proof, or key emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and 1px rules instead of ornamental shadow.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Use scale and weight for emphasis; reserve mono for measurement and execution vocabulary.

dos: Show the solver pipeline as real product vocabulary.
donts: Do not invent benchmark outcomes or commercial proof.
Do not replace polygon geometry with generic raster imagery.
Do not add gradient, glass, or rounded card-stack conventions.
